title: `/` of integers is a decimal rounded to 6 more places
verdict: `/` gives `NUMBER(p, 6)` rounded half up; zero raises; sverify divides exactly through `MOD`
description: `7 / 2` is `3.500000`, a `NUMBER(25,6)`: integer division is decimal division, rounded half away from zero at the scale (`2 / 3` is `0.666667`), so truncating it can be off by one (`299999999999999999 / 3` is `99999999999999999.666667`, but a quotient of `…999.9999995` would round up). The scale is the dividend's plus 6 (`NUMBER(10,2) / NUMBER(10,4)` has scale 8).
A zero divisor raises `100051 Division by zero`; `DIV0(a, 0)` and `DIV0NULL(a, 0)` are 0, and `DIV0NULL(a, NULL)` is 0. `MIN / -1` is `9223372036854775808.000000`: no overflow.
reference: `divide` truncates (`division_type: TRUNCATE`), raises on a zero divisor and on `MIN / -1` (`overflow`). sverify's SQL divides `a - MOD(a, b)` by `b`, which is exact, then checks the 64-bit range (`writer-trunc-div`, `writer-trunc-div-min`).

provenance.checked_by: sverify_dev.probe_snowflake through the Snowflake CLI (Snowflake characterization session)
provenance.notes: `sverify_dev.probe_snowflake` runs each query through `snow sql` (Snowflake CLI 3.32.1) on an X-Small warehouse, Snowflake 10.40.102, with the session's `TIMEZONE` set to UTC and `USE_CACHED_RESULT` off; every other parameter is the account's default, recorded in the header of probes.json (`WEEK_START` 0, `WEEK_OF_YEAR_POLICY` 0, `DEFAULT_NULL_ORDERING` LAST, `TIMESTAMP_TYPE_MAPPING` TIMESTAMP_NTZ). The inputs are literal `VALUES`, except the `sample-*` probes, which read TPC-H's LINEITEM (6,001,215 rows) in SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.
